tasks.name: חזקה של 2?
tasks.note: Flags 15 when a is a power of two (1, 2, 4 or 8) using the a AND (a-1) test, else 0.

tasks.name: הדלק את האפס הנמוך
tasks.note: Sets the lowest clear bit of a (a OR a+1), so 15 stays 15.

tasks.name: סכום הספרות
tasks.note: Sum of the decimal digits of a (10..15 become 1..6).

tasks.name: פלינדרום בינארי
tasks.note: Flags 15 when the 4-bit pattern of a reads the same in both directions (0, 6, 9, 15), else 0.

tasks.name: פיבונאצ'י מודולו 16
tasks.src: a=>{ let x=0, y=1; for(let i=0;i<a;i++){ const t=(x+y)&15; x=y; y=t; } return x; }
tasks.note: The a-th Fibonacci number modulo 16 (F0=0, F1=1), computed by a loop that keeps two running values.

tasks.name: מינימום מטבעות
tasks.note: Fewest coins of values 5, 2 and 1 that make the amount a (the greedy method is optimal here).

tasks.name: מספר רצפי האחדות
tasks.src: a=>{ let c=0, p=0; for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ const b=(a>>i)&1; if(b&&!p) c++; p=b; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the separate blocks of consecutive 1 bits in the 4-bit pattern of a (0, 1 or 2).

tasks.name: מספר המחלקים
tasks.src: a=>{ let c=0; for(let d=1;d<=a;d++) if(a%d===0) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Number of positive divisors of a, with 0 giving 0 (12 has the most, 6).

tasks.name: ההופכי מודולו 16
tasks.src: a=>{ for(let x=1;x<16;x+=2) if(((a*x)&15)===1) return x; return 0; }
tasks.note: Multiplicative inverse of an odd a modulo 16 (the x with a*x = 1 mod 16), and 0 for even a.

tasks.name: מהלכי פרש בלוח 4x4
tasks.note: Square a of a 4x4 board (row a>>2, column a&3): how many legal knight moves start there (2, 3 or 4).

tasks.name: שעות עד ההשכמה
tasks.note: Hours from now until the alarm on a 16-hour clock, always forward (wrapping subtraction alarm-now mod 16).

tasks.name: כפל רווי
tasks.note: Multiplication that saturates at 15 instead of wrapping.

tasks.name: הזזה שמאלה
tasks.note: Shifts a left by (b mod 4) places and drops the bits that leave the top (no wraparound).

tasks.name: תת-מסכה?
tasks.note: Flags 15 when every bit set in a is also set in b (a is a submask of b), else 0.

tasks.name: תרמוסטט
tasks.note: Thermostat with a dead band of 1 around the setpoint s: 1 = heat when t<s-1, 2 = cool when t>s+1, else 0.

tasks.name: סוף משחק בפינג-פונג
tasks.note: Table-tennis game result: 1 or 2 when that player has at least 11 points and leads by 2 or more, 0 while the game goes on.

tasks.name: מרחק מנהטן בלוח 4x4
tasks.note: Squares p and q of a 4x4 board (row = top two bits, column = low two bits): steps between them moving only along rows and columns.

tasks.name: חילוק שלם
tasks.note: Integer quotient floor(a/b), with division by zero returning 15 (all ones) as a divider circuit does.

tasks.name: שזירת ביטים
tasks.note: Morton interleave of the low two bits of a and b into a b1 a1 b0 a0 pattern (a's bits land on even positions).

tasks.name: הזזה ימינה עם סימן
tasks.note: Arithmetic right shift of a as a signed 4-bit number (8..15 = -8..-1) by (b mod 4): the sign bit is copied into the vacated top bits.

tasks.name: דירוג כוכבים
tasks.note: Star rating: g good reviews out of t shown as round(5*g/t) stars (halves round up), capped at 5, and 0 when t=0.

tasks.name: מלכה מאיימת
tasks.src: (p,q)=>{ if(p===q) return 0; const r1=p>>2, c1=p&3, r2=q>>2, c2=q&3; return (r1===r2||c1===c2||Math.abs(r1-r2)===Math.abs(c1-c2))?15:0; }
tasks.note: On a 4x4 board (row = top two bits, column = low two bits), flags 15 when a queen on p attacks q along a row, column or diagonal; same square = 0.

tasks.name: XOR של שלושה
tasks.note: Bitwise exclusive-or of three numbers (each bit is 1 when an odd number of inputs have it).

tasks.name: בתוך הלוח?
tasks.note: Flags 15 when the point (x, y) lies on an n-by-n board (both coordinates below n), else 0.

tasks.name: קופון עם מינימום הזמנה
tasks.note: A coupon worth c applies only when the price p reaches the minimum m, and the price never goes below 0.

tasks.name: רוב ביטי
tasks.note: Bitwise majority of three numbers: each bit is 1 when at least two of the inputs have it.

tasks.name: ביטים של אחד בלבד
tasks.note: Keeps the bits that are set in exactly one of the three inputs (XOR without the bits all three share).

tasks.name: כמה אפשר לקנות
tasks.note: Units affordable with money m at price p, limited by the stock s; a free item (p=0) gives the whole stock.

tasks.name: השעה אחרי רבעי שעה
tasks.note: Time is hour h plus (q mod 4) quarter-hours; after adding d quarter-hours, returns the new hour on a 16-hour clock (mixed-radix carry).

tasks.name: רוב מוחלט בבחירות
tasks.note: Votes a, b, c: returns the candidate (1, 2 or 3) holding more than half of all votes, or 0 when nobody has an absolute majority.

tasks.name: כפל מודולו ג
tasks.note: Product a*b (up to 225) reduced modulo a variable modulus c, with c=0 giving 0.

tasks.name: אינטרפולציה לינארית
tasks.note: Linear interpolation from a (t=0) to b (t=15) in 15 steps, rounded to the nearest whole number.

tasks.name: תשלומים שווים
tasks.note: Total a split into n near-equal installments with the larger ones first: returns installment k (counting from 0), or 0 when k>=n.

tasks.name: מיקום החציון
tasks.note: Position (0, 1 or 2) of the median of three after a stable sort, so on ties the earlier position comes first.
